defects.title: CORE_ZONE_BREAKOUT emits CLOSE_OUTSIDE on every bar outside a zone, even with no zone interaction
evidence: CORE_ZONE_BREAKOUT EURUSD 2026-03-24..2026-03-25: 21,920 signals of which 21,848 (99.7%) are close_outside
defects.expected: A signal should represent a zone interaction/state change; a close far outside an untouched zone should not emit one signal per zone per bar.
defects.actual: breakout.py:_detect_close_outside returns not zone.contains_price(close) unconditionally; _evaluate_zone emits CLOSE_OUTSIDE for every zone every bar.
defects.status: CONFIRMED (design/semantics defect; documented behavior but materially inflates signal counts)

defects.title: S002 retest signals can have zero risk distance and are silently rejected at the policy boundary without a termination record
evidence: S002 EURUSD 2026-03-23..2026-03-27: 516 signals, 230 accepted, 221 ignored (active lifecycle), 65 rejected_policy_boundary; all 65 have stop_hint == entry_hint because the retest bar closed at its low (LONG) or high (SHORT)
Only 7 rejects are recorded as REJECTED_INVALID_ENTRY; the 65 planner None rejects have no individual reason record
defects.repro: Run S002 EURUSD 2026-03-23..2026-03-27 and inspect execution/factories.py:41-46 + execution/policies.py:83-85
defects.expected: Either construct a non-zero structural stop (e.g. broken level) or record the rejection reason per setup so the UI can explain it.
defects.actual: TradeSetupFactory sets stop_hint=current_bar.low/high. When the retest candle closes at that extreme, entry_hint==stop_hint, FixedRiskRewardPolicy.build returns None (risk_distance<=1e-12), and BacktestRunner only increments rejected_policy_boundary_count.
defects.status: CONFIRMED (observability/execution-model defect; 12.6% of S002 signals in the evidence range)

defects.title: UI cannot pre-validate zone availability for zone-requiring strategies (AUDUSD + S002/CORE)
evidence: /api/strategies returns requires_zones=true but no per-symbol zone catalog
frontend/src/pages/ResearchPage.tsx submit() validates range/R/equity/risk only; it relies on the POST /api/backtests 400 detail for the missing-zone error
defects.repro: Select AUDUSD + S002 in Strategy Lab and press Run; the request reaches POST /api/backtests and returns 400 "No zone book is configured for AUDUSD in config/zones.json".
defects.expected: The lab should disable or warn on a known-incompatible dataset+strategy combination before submission.
defects.actual: The guarded error is explicit and safe, but only appears after submit; there is no zone-availability API.
defects.status: CONFIRMED (UX/integration gap; service-level validation itself is correct)

defects.title: BacktestRunner defaults to SweepTradeSetupFactory for any strategy when simulate_trades=True
evidence: backtests/backtest_runner.py:79 sets factory = setup_factory or SweepTradeSetupFactory()
Direct BacktestRunner.run(S002, ..., simulate_trades=True) without a factory yields 0 trades because sweep factory returns None for retest signals
defects.expected: The runner should require or infer the strategy-specific factory, or fail explicitly.
defects.actual: It silently accepts unrelated signals, counts them as rejected_policy_boundary, and returns zero trades.
defects.status: CONFIRMED (API footgun; research_service avoids it by passing the correct factory)

not_claimed: No profitability claim: costs are not applied; results are gross R-multiples on small bounded samples.
